scenarios.label: Chain node restart
failureModes: Primary Substrate node panics mid-anchor batch
RPC layer drops inflight auditScrapbook requests
ChainClient retry budget exhausted before reconnect

recoveryPlan.autoReconnect: Exponential backoff with jitter, rehydrate receipts locally when RPC unavailable
recoveryPlan.fallBack: Build local receipt so issuances continue even if RPC is offline

scenarios.label: Issuer key rotation
failureModes: Old proofs remain accepted after rotation window
New issuer keys not broadcast to verifiers
Cache retains stale public JWKS snapshot
detectionSignals: Verification queue spikes after rotation event

recoveryPlan.cacheBust: Force refresh signing key cache when a rotation event is observed
recoveryPlan.negativeTest: Ensure proofs signed with retired kid fail validation immediately

scenarios.label: Revocation storm
failureModes: ChainClient audit events time out under sustained load
Revocation audit anchors missing for subset of credentials
detectionSignals: Status list snapshot hash drift vs expected

recoveryPlan.batching: Chunk revocations into 1k groups with retry-safe audit anchors
recoveryPlan.snapshotValidation: Take full status list snapshot after storm to confirm 100% coverage

scenarios.label: OCR overload
failureModes: Issuer extraction HITL queue saturates > 1 minute
Preview garbage routed to automated pipeline instead of HITL
Upload latency exceeds SLA for 95th percentile
detectionSignals: hitl route ratio < 90% for garbage previews

recoveryPlan.backpressure: Throttle new uploads when extractor pool saturated
recoveryPlan.triage: Force manual review for previews with entropy score < 0.35
